$comment: Runtime config for this landing. This file is served as-is from the public folder and is fetched by the page on every load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT a rebuild. Reload the page (or let the dev watcher pick it up) and the landing re-renders.

game.$comment: Each tap on the bird / SPIN costs `bet` and plays the next entry of `taps`: effect = spin | drunk | zap, payout = bet × winMultiplier. After the last tap the CTA popup opens.

texts.rotateNotice: Please rotate your device to portrait mode

sound.$comment: All sounds are synthesized in the browser (WebAudio) — there are no audio files. enabled = initial state of the sound button.

assets.$comment: Values are either a built-in key (a filename under src/assets/img, no extension) or a URL. A URL starting with / , ./ , http:// or https:// is used verbatim, so you can drop custom art into the public folder and point at it here.

dev.$comment: watch polls this file and re-renders the landing in place when it changes. menu enables the config editor panel (also in production builds, where it saves to this browser's localStorage only).
